maya: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-routing tweak I'm seeing a regression for streaming + continuous batching users. p99 up ~12-20% on short responses ( <30 tokens ) when kv is cold :eyes:
liam: link to the perf graphs? job id?
maya: https://perf.internal/runs/abc123 (check 'streaming_small_responses' trace)
priya: my first guess is batch formation + token-budget aggregation is causing partial-decode starvation. streaming requests wait for the minibatch window, then early-flush fires and we end up with tiny kernels selected and extra kernel-switch overhead.
sam: also saw kv-cache warmup spikes in that trace — a bunch of misses during the first 3 tokens which forces different kernel path. decode_stalls jumped too.
maya: quick metrics from the run: p50 85ms -> 90ms, p95 210ms -> 260ms, p99 420ms -> 480ms, decode_stalls +16%
maya: reproduction command I ran locally:
```
curl -s 'http://perf/trace?id=abc123' | jq '.events[] | select(.type=="partial_decode") | {latency:.latency_ms, kv_hit:.kv_hit}' | head -n 5
```
toni: two low-effort knobs to try: reduce streaming flush_cadence from 12ms -> 8ms (fewer long-wait partial decodes) OR lower token_budget_target for streaming requests so the scheduler sends smaller batches earlier.
priya: agree — also suggest adding a quick heuristic: if avg_prefix_len < 30 and kv_hit_rate < 0.6 prefer "small-kernel" path to avoid kernel-selection penalty during early tokens. we should keep the threshold conservative.
liam: I'll run an A/B: token_budget_target 16 vs 24, and toggle kv_prefetch=true for the streaming path. rolling canary on a single pool. tagging @ops for capacity.
infra-bot: Deploy started: rollout/streaming-kernel-heuristics-canary -> pool/staging (deploy id: dpl-789).
sam: if we see improvement, we should add a micro-benchmark that simulates many short streaming requests to prevent regression. maybe a unit that runs both cold-kv and warm-kv cases in CI.
maya: +1 on the micro-benchmark. Please post results here.
liam: will update in ~30m with early numbers.
maya: thanks! keeping this thread for updates / anchor for action items. :thumbsup:
